name: godot_verify
description: Check a result by measurement. criteria: your own acceptance checks, each a Godot Expression measured on a scene and passed or failed with the measured value. errors (default on): the nodes whose script does not compile; with saved or frames, also the errors Godot logged loading and running the scene. Without saved or frames: the open scene, in the editor. saved: the same checks on the scene file as written on disk, read by a background --headless Godot (the editor stays free); check the delivered files before reporting. frames: run the scene that many frames first (its scripts run, as in the game; at a fixed 60 fps) for runtime values, in a background Godot, on a working copy of the open scene or on the saved file. Past timeout_s the background Godot is stopped and the answer says what it was doing. Nothing in the open scene changes.

criteria.description: Up to 50 checks: {expr: a Godot Expression; op: true (default) == != < <= > >= approx between in contains; value; tol (approx, default 1e-4); label}. In expr: scene and root (the scene's root node), node(path) (relative to the root), exists(path), prop(path, name), children(path), nodes(class) (paths), count(class), in_group(path, group), script_of(path), and Godot's own types and functions: node("Player").position.y, count("MeshInstance3D"), node("Light").light_energy. Vectors and colors compare as [x, y, z] element by element.

errors.description: Report the scripts that do not compile and the errors logged.

saved.description: true: the open scene's file as saved on disk; or a scene file (res://..., a path relative to the project, or absolute).

frames.description: Run the scene this many frames (at 60 fps) before measuring, in a background Godot.

timeout_s.description: For saved and frames: how long the background Godot may take (5 to 3600).
